description: Open a chest/barrel/shulker/dispenser/hopper at a block coordinate (x,y,z) or a container entity (entityId, e.g. a chest minecart). Keeps the window open as the active container session for read_open_container / container_deposit / container_withdraw until close_window.

cursorPos.description: Optional cursor position on the block face

entityId.description: Open a container entity instead of a block (e.g. chest minecart)

x.description: X of the container block (omit if using entityId)

name: open_container
